Team — forwarding Meridian's asks. Key asks to address before Oct 12 packet:
- Produce a one-page measurable Activation TAT definition (what counts as "first successful production inference")
- Confirm prorated invoice behavior if activation occurs mid-month
- Confirm co-sell enablement policy when payment is staged (do we allow enablement prior to final settlement?)

My proposed answers: Activation TAT = first 24-hour window with >=95% successful requests against their registered integration with Redwood Dedicated, measured by trace ids. Proration = yes, we can prorate to month end for activation payment. Co-sell = we can enable co-sell activities (sales demos, joint GTM assets) once 50% signature payment clears and PO is submitted to Redwood; final entitlement (credit recognition) triggered on activation. Legal evidence = Naomi can publish the evidence package to the secure drive link and we can provide signing access.

Please review, add redlines. We should decide if Vanessa escalates to Legal Ops for a faster turnaround.
